metricProposalBasis: {n} in proposal, from orders or quotes on record
metricWonNoValue: No order value on record yet
metricConversionNone: No leads created in the last {days} days
metricConversionSources: Last {days} days, won of leads created: {sources}
loadFailedTitle: The Sales workbench could not be loaded
loadFailedBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
attentionEmptyBody: Decisions, overdue steps, customers waiting for a reply and failed steps show up here the moment they appear.
reasonHint: At least {n} characters. It is kept with the customer as the evidence of the outcome.
moveWonNote: A won deal is handed to Accounting, which prepares the invoice through your authority rules.
decisionsEmptyBody: Quotes, orders over your limit and drafts that need your approval appear here.
waitingManager: Waiting for the owner or manager to decide.
decidedBody: Who decided, when, and on what basis.
decidedEmptyBody: Every sales decision a person makes is recorded here.
handoffIntro: Confirmed orders and where their invoice stands. The invoice is an internal record that Accounting prepares.
handoffEmptyBody: Once an order is confirmed it appears here with its invoice status.
wonNoOrderHint: Won without an order on record. Accounting asks for the amount before it can invoice.
work_waiting_decision: Accounting is waiting for a decision.
handoffResult_queued: Handed over. Accounting is working on it.
handoffResult_done: Handed over. The invoice is recorded.
handoffResult_waiting_decision: Handed over. Accounting needs a decision before it invoices.
handoffResult_rejected: Handed over, but the step was stopped.
handoffResult_failed: The hand-off failed. You can try again.
activityIntro: Routine work NIVO completed by itself inside the authority you gave, each with its evidence.
activityEmptyBody: When NIVO finishes routine Sales work by policy, it is listed here.
byPolicy: Done by policy, no decision needed
errChanged: That step was already changed by someone else.
errNotFailed: Only a failed step can be retried or stopped.
errNotConfirmed: Only a confirmed order can be handed to Accounting.
errAlreadyInvoiced: This order already has an invoice.
shipNote: The customer is told the carrier and tracking code when the Delivery notice automation is on.
shipCarrierHint: For example Giao Hàng Nhanh, Viettel Post, J&T
shipDone: Order {no} is marked as handed to the carrier.
contractsIntro: Recurring contracts. The Contract renewal automation reminds the customer and opens a follow-up for sales before the end date.
contractsEmptyBody: Add a recurring contract to be reminded before it ends.
contractEndHint: Change this date when the contract is renewed.
errNotShippable: Only a confirmed order can be marked as shipped.
errAlreadyShipped: This order is already marked as shipped.
errContractDates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errContractAmount: The amount must be zero or more.
